items.title: Garrett Wilson: Slated to return Sunday
items.text:
Wilson (concussion) is expected to be cleared to play against the Bills on Sunday, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

items.title: Omar Cooper: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Cooper (ankle), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills, is expected to be available, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Will be Kansas City's RB1 vs. Atlanta
items.text:
Johnson will be the Chiefs' top running back for Week 10 after Kenneth Walker (groin) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Won't play against Atlanta
items.text:
Walker (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Jordan Schultz of Fox Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Travis Etienne: Expected to be activated from IR
items.text:
The Saints are expected to activate Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's NFC South tilt against the Panthers, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
